{{Top|leg}}
'''Spot-lumas''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> or '''spotlight lumas''',<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> were illumination devices. They could emit beams of light up to a distance of three hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="EGWT" /> They came in a variety of sizes and shapes, from thin targeting beams to larger flash beams. They could be programmed to pulse, strobe, flash, glow or twinkle depending on the programming.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>

The [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] had over 10,000 robotically controlled spot-lumas.<ref name="WHSV" /> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] employed spot-lumas, and smaller versions could be mounted on weapons.<ref name="NDP">{{JournalCite|14|No Disintegrations, Please}}</ref>
